blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CCDRRMO) has recommended engineering and drainage safeguards, an emergency evacuation plan and an early-warning sign for a proposed ecotourism park in Barangay Sapangdaku, Cebu City. The recommendations followed a September 25, 2026, risk assessment of the proposed Geo Eco Park in Sitio Baksan, which the office found to be in an area highly susceptible to landslides based on the Mines and Geosciences Bureau’s (MGB) geohazard map. The CCDRRMO said the site could be developed, provided appropriate engineering designs, adequate drainage provisions, and necessary environmental mitigation and preservation measures […]...
